summary: Healthy Extracts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with LABRYS FUND II, L.P., under which it issued a $258,750 principal promissory note with a 10% interest rate, original issue discount of $33,750, and net proceeds of $225,000. The note matures in one year, is non-prepayable without consent, and becomes convertible after 180 days at the lower of $2.00/share or 75% of the lowest closing bid price over the prior 15 trading days. Monthly amortization payments of $36,964.28 begin January 18, 2027 for six months. The note and conversion shares were sold in a private placement to an accredited investor under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act, with no general solicitation.
